raw_text: India has accused Pakistan's military media wing ISPR of releasing a deepfake video purportedly showing an Indian Air Force pilot criticising India. New Delhi's Press Information Bureau labelled the video as AI-generated and referred the matter to cyber crime authorities. Indian fact-checkers have pointed to lip-sync inconsistencies and uniform errors in the footage. While ISPR has not officially commented on the specific allegations, defence analysts note that AI-generated content has become an increasingly common tool in the information space between the two nuclear-armed neighbours. The timing of the video's release, weeks before India's general elections, has drawn particular scrutiny from international observers.
